title: Weak-mutation selection on Model S designs: mode, equipartition, low-beta spread
world_generator: Same distribution as core/keystone_checks/s5_rerun.py world() / convexity_targeted.py, but rng = default_rng(BASE_WORLD_SEED+i), not 1000+seed. Fresh seeds, checked non-colliding with S5 1000-1119, convexity_search 0-119, wide 5000-5119, and named seeds 20261120 / 2026112020.

predictions.P1: At each locked high beta, on the coarse K=0..3 grid, the mode of the pooled Moran occupation equals the unique grid argmin of reduced J.
predictions.P2: At each locked high beta, on the whitened K=2 lattice, beta times the mean excess cost approaches d/2 = 1 within 20% relative error.
predictions.P3: At the locked low beta, on the coarse grid, the mean reduced J is strictly above J*, at least two layer counts K have occupation mass >= 0.10, and the excess is at least twice the mean high-beta coarse excess.

pass_rule: OVERALL PASS iff there are 3 official-valid worlds and every official world passes P1, P2 and P3. If fewer than 3 official-valid worlds, the test is INCONCLUSIVE, not a fail. A world that fails a mixing or interior-min validity check is not official; it does not count as a prediction fail.
notes: Pilot design work used only the already-published S5 world rng seed 1000 (convexity_targeted seed 0). Official seeds were not evaluated before lock.
